claims.statement: The deepagents.middleware package re-exports its public middleware classes and supporting types for filesystem, summarization, skills, subagents, async subagents, memory, rubric, and unsupported content from its __init__.py, defining the surface consumers import from deepagents.middleware.

Middleware subclasses AgentMiddleware and overrides hooks such as wrap_model_call() that intercept every LLM request before it is sent, letting it filter tools, inject system-prompt context, transform messages, and maintain cross-turn state — capabilities a plain tools= callable (invoked only after the model calls it) cannot provide.

FilesystemMiddleware builds an allowlisted filesystem tool set from ls, read_file, write_file, edit_file, delete, glob, grep, and execute; read_file is required in an explicit allowlist, while execute and delete remain subject to backend capability checks.

The summarization module provides SummarizationMiddleware (automatic threshold-triggered compaction that offloads evicted history to a backend), SummarizationToolMiddleware (an on-demand compact_conversation tool), and the create_summarization_tool_middleware factory.

SkillsMiddleware implements Anthropic's agent skills pattern with progressive disclosure, loading skills from one or more backend sources (later sources overriding earlier by name) and injecting instructions into the system prompt using backend APIs only.
SubAgentMiddleware exposes a task tool that delegates work to synchronous subagents which block until completion.

AsyncSubAgentMiddleware launches background subagent runs on remote Agent Protocol servers via the LangGraph SDK and returns a task id immediately so the main agent can monitor progress, in contrast to synchronous subagents that block.

MemoryMiddleware loads configured AGENTS.md sources into private memory_contents state and injects the resulting persistent context into the system prompt by default; system_prompt=None suppresses injection without suppressing loading.

RubricMiddleware invokes a separate grader sub-agent each time the agent would otherwise finish; a needs_revision verdict injects feedback as a HumanMessage and resumes the loop, repeating until satisfied, failed, or max_iterations is reached.

PatchToolCallsMiddleware runs in before_agent and repairs dangling tool calls: for every valid or invalid AIMessage tool call with an id lacking a matching ToolMessage, it appends an error ToolMessage that records either an incomplete call or malformed/truncated arguments, then rewrites the history.

_fs_interrupt is glue that converts FilesystemPermission interrupt-mode rules into an interrupt_on mapping for HumanInTheLoopMiddleware via a per-call when predicate; FilesystemMiddleware itself only enforces deny rules and does not know about HITL.

_message_eviction supplies the shared generic tool-result offload helper used by FilesystemMiddleware and SummarizationMiddleware's overflow fallback: a successful write replaces text with a line-numbered head-and-tail preview while preserving non-text blocks, and a failed write leaves the original message in place.

_prompt_caching's append_prompt_caching_middleware always appends AnthropicPromptCachingMiddleware and conditionally appends Bedrock and Fireworks prompt-caching middleware when the corresponding langchain-aws / langchain-fireworks packages are installed.

_ToolExclusionMiddleware filters harness-profile-excluded tools out of the model request and should be placed late in the stack so it can strip middleware-injected tools; excluded names are also rejected at the tool-call boundary to keep execution consistent with what was advertised.

_video is the optional boundary to the PyAV video backend, imported lazily so installs without the [video] extra stay lightweight; for a video read it decodes a time-window slice and emits sampled frames as interleaved text+image content blocks, interpreting read_file's offset/limit as seconds.

Graph construction makes SkillsMiddleware, FilesystemMiddleware, optional synchronous and asynchronous subagent middleware, summarization, and PatchToolCallsMiddleware built-in harness behavior; it then layers profile middleware, provider caching, optional memory, HITL, UnsupportedContentMiddleware, consumer middleware, and finally tool exclusion.

CompositeBackend owns an artifacts_root setting, defaulting to `/`; FilesystemMiddleware and SummarizationMiddleware derive their large-tool-results and conversation-history prefixes from it after removing a trailing slash, and focused tests verify default and custom-root placement.

Offloaded tool-result paths use a sanitized, bounded tool-call ID: dots and path separators become underscores, IDs exceeding 128 UTF-8 bytes become a SHA-256-derived call name, and model-visible notices abbreviate IDs longer than 32 characters.

FilesystemMiddleware proactively evicts oversized results only after a tool call returns and skips ls, glob, grep, read_file, edit_file, write_file, and delete; SummarizationMiddleware instead invokes tail clipping only during input-budget or provider-overflow recovery.

UnsupportedContentMiddleware filters each model request against the active model profile, replacing unsupported human and tool multimodal blocks with text notices while retaining the original thread messages; it must be placed last when used directly and is automatically added by create_deep_agent.
